lines.text: Same washing machine. Same wash. Thirty-one p, or thirteen p.
The only difference is when you press start.
Cheap Watts uses live prices for your tariff. Pick an appliance, and it finds the cheapest time to run it.
You get the cost, the greenest time, and exactly what to set your delay timer to.
Got the washing, the dishwasher and the car to do? It plans the whole evening for you.
Kettle or hob? Heater or central heating? It does the maths at today's prices.
Upload your smart meter data, and see whether switching tariff would save you money.
It's free, and there's no sign up. Cheap watts, dot co dot u k.
